violations.text: Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination. Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Staff failed to sanitize equipment and utensils after washing and rinsing them. After being cleaned, equipment and utensils must be sanitized in the 3-bay-sink or dishwasher. PIC informed and 3 bay sink was set up and tested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Various steam table items were observed held between 105-120 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Beef chili relleno and batter fried bamboo were observed held at between 85-87 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC placed in cooler for active cooling based on time. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Inspector observed beans, soup, and sauce cooling in the walk-in cooler in large pots greater than four inches deep. PIC removed items and placed in shallower containers. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The door to the outside, located on the side, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Inspector observed various meats stored on the floor in the kitchen area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC relocated meat. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The floors and walls near cooking areas have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Employees' clothing or other personal belongings were observed stored on food shelves in the kitchen area and on top of flour in the mop sink area. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026
Outside walk in freezer door gaskets were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2025

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (back outside) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2025
The floor and wall junctures in the (kitchen) do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/12/2025
